note: Bosque County (TX) has no public zoning district layer in ArcGIS Online/Hub or county GIS downloads; Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. Clifton's city maps page lists no zoning layer, and searches for Meridian, Clifton and Valley Mills turned up no official zoning GIS service. Only third-party zoning sites (Zoneomics, Regrid) were found.
